1 1/2 cups fine bread flour

3 tbsp olive oil

3 large eggs, lightly beaten

1 tsp salt

1 tbsp white vinegar or lemon juice

1 1/2 cups grated Parmesan cheese

Heat oven to 350 F. Grease and flour a 9x5 inch loaf pan. In a medium saucepan, combine milk, sugar, yeast and olive oil. Stir to mix well. Let sit in warm room until bubbly and foamy.
